title: 184. Search Insert Position

examples.explanation: Target 2 is not present; inserting it keeps order at index 1.
Target 7 is larger than all elements; it would be appended at index 4.

hints: Use binary search for the lower bound: the first index with nums[i] >= target.
Keep an inclusive interval with left <= right and move left to mid+1 when nums[mid] < target.
Compute the midpoint as left + (right - left) / 2 to avoid overflow.
